abbQuestion: When will the historian retention disk fill? (a forecast crossing-anticipation with a band)

expectFindings.why: the container's writable layer fills linearly ~6Mi/min toward the declared-limit-derived 54.4Mi bar; while still SUB-BAR it is a MEASURED healthy-but-rising series.

expectForecast.why: the clock (TimesFM) projects container_fs_usage_bytes crossing the 54.4Mi bar minutes ahead while still sub-bar, emitted as a crossing-anticipation carrying an uncertainty BAND that never collapses to a line.

nonGating.statement: Detection never waits on forecasting. With the clock absent or degraded the MEASURED rising-disk finding is byte-identical, and the forecast is simply ABSENT — no fabricated ETA is substituted.
nonGating.charter: Non-gating (absolute): the deterministic path produces identical results whether the clock is present, degraded, or absent.

mustNotFabricate.statement: The crossing-anticipation is PROJECTED and must be surfaced as PROJECTED on /api/warnings — never restated as a MEASURED fact in feeds, chat, or summaries.
mustNotFabricate.charter: PROJECTED restated as MEASURED is rejected anywhere.

mustNotFabricate.statement: The forecast must carry a mandatory uncertainty band. A single point ETA (band collapsed to a line) is a charter violation.
mustNotFabricate.charter: PROJECTED forecasts carry a mandatory uncertainty band that never collapses to a line.

mustNotFabricate.statement: The bar is the DECLARED ephemeral-storage limit (54.4Mi = 0.85 x 64Mi), never a learned or behavioural threshold.
mustNotFabricate.charter: Borrowed normativity: thresholds come from the customer's declared limits.

note: The historian-disk question is answered with a PROJECTED, banded crossing-anticipation against the customer-declared limit, surfaced ADJACENTLY to (never fused with) the MEASURED rising-disk finding.
